text: Could you make a clip with two clearly different voices having a friendly, natural conversation? I have a little exchange in mind that reminds me of getting ready to head out with a friend. What I want is one audio-only clip, around 8 seconds, with A as the lower voice and B as the higher voice. Please read only these lines in this order, not the labels: A: “Ready to go?” B: “Almost. Have you got the tickets?” A: “Right here.” B: “Great, let's go!” I always find these tiny everyday conversations surprisingly charming. Please don't include any music or sound effects.
